reviews.title: Fairly accurate sleep tracker
reviews.text: In general, I think this sleep tracker is fairly accurate, but it persistently records me as sleeping when I am sitting and reading, or even driving for long periods when I am not the least bit drowsy. In fact, it has recorded me as sleeping during these times when I was doing chores in the kitchen or pumping gas.

reviews.title: REM app
reviews.text: So overall I like this app but my only problem is that my watch did not show me that I had slept at all and it said no session but another app on my watch gave me a full breakdown of my sleep. Also it said I was sleeping from 2:00 pm to 5:50 am which is not true. Also the sleep data did not match up with that other app and  it got all messed up. But overall I would say that this app would be my second choice when it comes to sleep apps my number one sleep app would be the apple sleep app that also connects with health. So if you are looking for a dependable sleep app this one is probably not going to work unless it is the only option then go for it.
